content_data.project_title: Engage & Learn: Mobile-First Content Strategy for European Youth
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive content strategy proposal focused on creating engaging, culturally relevant, and mobile-optimized educational content to attract and retain young European learners.
content_data.timeline: Over the next 12 months, with initial content development in months 1-3 and iterative refinement thereafter.
objectives: Develop a scalable content framework that supports rapid localization and cultural adaptation.
deliverables: Recommendations for content localization and cultural adaptation processes
Comprehensive Content Strategy Document (including audience personas, content pillars, and editorial calendar)
